clips.title: The story
paras: Past the Moonshrine Ruins, Forgotten Pool lies beneath the flooded halls of Blackfathom Deeps. Its dark waters hide monstrous deep-sea predators.

You reach Forgotten Pool by diving through the sunken waterways beyond the Moonshrine Ruins. Dark water fills this isolated cavern, cut off from dry ground. Twilight's Hammer cultists chant nearby, and naga patrol the flooded halls, but the pool lies apart from them. Old Serra'kis, an ancient aquatic terror, lairs in its depths, hidden by the water.
